_comment: Copy this file to integrations.json (gitignored) and fill in your own credentials. Never commit integrations.json.

ebay._howToGet: developer.ebay.com -> sign in -> Application Keys. Create a 'production' keyset. redirectUri must match a RuName you configure there (or use their auth accepted URL flow).

gmail._howToGet: console.cloud.google.com -> new project -> enable 'Gmail API' -> OAuth consent screen (External, Testing mode is fine for personal use) -> Credentials -> OAuth Client ID -> type 'Web application' -> add redirectUri below as an authorized redirect URI.
